st: among diamonds, art, sperm and carotid arteries

sec.p: Let's not demonise plastic: it does good too, especially for preserving food (Bressanini, always on the ball).
We can turn it into art.

sec.t: ff.130.3 Microplastics: where do they come from?
sec.p: As you can see, plastic is everywhere. Even in the air.
Microplastics are so widespread that not even superman-wannabe Bryan Johnson can escape them (💊 ff.49.4 The superman who takes 100 pills a day).
But what effects do microplastics have on our health?
